note: PASSIVE registry (v2 plan T9 / CM2). id/file/title/trigger text ONLY. The skeleton's Phase 2 pattern table and the Arguments table decide WHEN to read a recipe; no machine predicate here (plan D3).

sections.title: Flake recipe: reproduce on main, failure rate over N runs, cause inside or outside the PR, gh run list comparison, forced probe, never loosen, the `## Flake evidence` PR-body section
sections.trigger: investigating a test that fails intermittently or only in CI (a flake), before any rerun, timeout or skip

sections.title: Polluter recipe: file order from the CI log, bisect the earlier files with ship-measure free --files, report the polluter and what it leaked
sections.trigger: investigating a test that passes alone and fails in the suite or in one shard (order-dependent)

sections.title: Race recipe: timing probes, forced interleaving, the concurrent-writer template
sections.trigger: investigating a timing-dependent failure or corrupted shared state (a race), before proposing a fix

sections.title: Eval bisect recipe: distinct revisions, a cached cheap scorer, detached runs, paid cases never retried
sections.trigger: investigating a judged or scored metric that regressed between two revisions (an eval bisect)

sections.title: Backlog mode: classify each open issue still_open / already_fixed <commit> / partially_fixed / owned_elsewhere, read-only table, no closing
sections.trigger: running `/investigate --backlog` (read-only issue triage instead of Phases 1–5)
